notes: A mortal receives the six open destination-name lines in C direction order.
do_exits does not parse or reject trailing command arguments; the exits list is unchanged.
Missing and closed exits leave the list empty and emit the exact None line.
The POS_RESTING command remains callable after sleep and reaches do_exits.
An open north exit is rendered while an east exit marked EX_CLOSED is omitted.
A mortal without infravision sees Too dark to tell for dark destinations.
An Implementor receives destination vnums and names even when the destination is dark.
AFF_BLIND short-circuits before exit iteration with the exact blindness response.
AFF_INFRAVISION lets a mortal render the dark destination name instead of the concealment line.
